title: REQ · Admin execution list, retry and approve endpoints
summary: File-backed execution records with list, retry and approve behind admin token
description: Context: no execution model exists. Desired behavior: development/executions/<id>.yaml records (id, world_id, round_id, status, error, updated_at); GET /api/v1/admin/executions lists them; POST executions/{id}/retry moves FAILED to QUEUED; POST executions/{id}/approve moves AWAITING_APPROVAL to APPROVED; changes committed via Git. Expected result: admin can retry and approve.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored executions, when GET list, then all are returned as JSON
Given a FAILED execution, when retry, then status QUEUED; otherwise 409
Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when approve, then status APPROVED; otherwise 409
Given an unknown or unsafe id, when retry or approve, then 404; no token gives 401
technical_constraints: Validate id with safepath.Segment; atomic write then Committer.Commit
